text:
The Story of the Frog and the King's Sense of Humor
A New Patient
Once, His Majesty King Bhumibol Adulyadej traveled to Phuparn Rajanives Palace in Sakon Nakhon Province to visit people in remote areas. While visiting the people, he saw villagers making pottery in the shape of a frog with its hand covering its chin, as if someone had a toothache. He asked to buy the frog. Upon returning to his residence, he radioed one of his personal dentists to send a patient with a toothache for treatment. The dentist eagerly awaited the patient. Later, it turned out that the dentist received a special patient in the form of a pottery frog as a gift. As a result, the dentist felt relieved and appreciated that, even in His Majesty's sense of humor, he still remembered the dentists. Received as a gift on January 7, 1984.
Dental Department, Development Medical Center Clinic
